submission.justification: Selection-S1 has the highest nominal significance (4.1 sigma in the 2025 study) but its validation-region data/MC disagreement is 35% because the jet-substructure inputs are poorly modelled. That violates the hard 10% limit, so it is excluded. Of the remaining strategies, S3 (6% disagreement) passes the limit and gives higher significance than S2 (3%) at every working point scanned. The S3 scan peaks at 50% signal efficiency with 3.43 sigma (statistical uncertainty only); neighbouring points were 3.34 (45%), 3.29 (55%), 3.31 (60%) and 3.17 (40%), and 70% gave 3.19. S2 peaked at 2.57 sigma (50%). The result is statistical-only, so the 6% validation-region mismodelling should be carried into the systematic uncertainty budget.

requirements.requirement: Selection must be one of the three candidate strategies
requirements.evidence: Selection-S3 (NN on kinematic variables) from candidate_specs.md

requirements.requirement: Data/MC yield disagreement in signal-free validation region must not exceed 10% for the variables used

requirements.evidence: Working point chosen at 50% signal efficiency

requirements.requirement: Goal: highest possible expected signal significance
requirements.evidence: S3 at 50%: 3.43 sigma, the highest among the eligible strategies and working points scanned (S2 max 2.57 sigma); S1 not eligible
